author: bardic-inspiration
name: Bulwark of Vigil
summary: A shield that warns of hidden danger and can leap to block an ally's harm.
description: Veteran guards of the border wall carve a small notch into it for every night survived. It is nearly black with the notches.

stats.effect: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wielding this shield (in addition to the shield's normal bonus). You have Advantage on Initiative rolls. As a Reaction when an ally within 5 feet is hit by an attack, you can switch places with the ally and become the target instead.
